findings.summary: The original family round3 and L2 theorems require native faithfulness/aggregate admission in BOTH kernels; the packet reruns only the 8eb leg and labels old native results historical-only without stating how the historical-kernel (1ae86d) leg is carried. I verified that every nonempty stage pair file is JSON-identical to the approved forward/reverse pair files accepted by 1ae86d and 41c680, so the leg carries by exact input invariance. Recommend stating: historical-kernel leg invariant reuse, 1a leg superseded, 8eb leg fresh.

capture.json grouping is the hard-coded constant None (presentation of the asserted live none) and built_len is len(C raw built diagrams); both equal the old values and the L2 run-provenance checks consume them, but the constant mapping should be documented explicitly as such.

The QED outer capture-validate.mjs checks (None==Auto bytes, source companions, census completion, numerator FNV) are not mapped to fresh evidence in the packet. Verified here on fresh data: None/Auto dumps byte-identical to each other and to old current (so FNV identical as input identity, not a theorem), companions equal, census completed with D0 key.

With the reserved additive witness, sign/coefficient/power booleans are satisfied by the witness coefficient alone and carry no information about the pair; the mathematical content is parsed/canonical equality, which is injective under additive cancellation in Symbolica sum normal form. This matches the approved round3 design; the phrase five predicates should not be read as five independent checks.

The packet adapter takes owner order from the old typed-owners file per diagram. A C-only fixed tail rotation reproduces identical bytes, and raw C order is accepted with identical obligation multisets, so there is no hidden dependence on old values.

The packet sandbox binds the whole runtime root (including runner-written command/stdout/stderr) writable at /work; the helper writes only results.json and the results were reproduced independently, so there is no impact; separating evidence records from the writable bind would tighten containment.

Inherited label anchor_self_comparisons now counts C-vs-B cross-capture anchors (current anchors point to old B), which is stronger than the approved self-comparison; the label is inherited byte-identically.
